title: dev.qory.ping
description: Sent to the server's events endpoint before the runtime starts, when a server is configured. The server answers a signed 2xx or the run does not start; a run is live from its accepted ping until its final event, or until no accepted event has arrived for 3 × interval_seconds.

runner_version.description: The runner module version, as Go stamps it.

events.description: The event types the server receives, as its configuration lists them.

contract_version.description: The revision of this contract the runner implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header.

interval_seconds.description: The heartbeat interval the run uses, in seconds: heartbeats run from the accepted ping until the run's final event, so the server's liveness window follows the run's own value. A larger value fails the schema, a signed 400 invalid_request.
